steps.en: Install the adapter for your framework
steps.zh: 安装对应框架的适配包

steps.en: Create one client and provide it at the app root
steps.zh: 创建一个客户端，放在应用根部

steps.en: In each component, name the data by key and give the fetch function
steps.zh: 每个组件用键说明要什么数据，并给出请求函数

steps.en: Dedupes identical keys, caches the result, hands every reader the same copy
steps.zh: 相同的键只请求一次，缓存结果，所有读者拿到同一份

steps.en: Refetches stale data in the background on remount, focus or reconnect; retries failures
steps.zh: 重新挂载、窗口聚焦或网络恢复时后台重拉过期数据，失败自动重试

steps.en: After a write, invalidate the affected keys
steps.zh: 写操作成功后，让受影响的键失效

steps.en: Marks matching queries stale and refetches the ones on screen
steps.zh: 把匹配的查询标脏，重拉屏幕上正在用的那些

value.en: No more hand-written loading/error state or duplicate requests; screens stay in sync with the server after writes
value.zh: 不再手写 loading／error 状态、不再重复请求；写完之后各处页面自动和服务端保持一致
